suites.title: One order end to end
suites.what: Offer, signature, approval, order, and the refusals on the way: wrong product, missed cut-off, a price that moved.

suites.title: What an agent can see and do
suites.what: No stock counts, no other customers' data, rate limits, the per-reader ledger.

suites.title: After the order
suites.what: Short pick, delay and batch recall: what the agent may settle alone and what goes to a person.

suites.title: Menu to order
suites.what: Recipe quantities, pack sizes, dietary rules per dish, a shortage solved by what the ingredient does, a photo that is not a menu.

suites.title: Valio Aimo's own agent
suites.what: Proposals are checked against the buyer's limits before they leave; a declined one is never made again.

suites.title: Fair split under shortage
suites.what: Many agents, one short product: split by contract share, care kitchens first, never promised twice.

suites.title: Attacks from outside
suites.what: Forged tokens, replayed offers, other accounts' orders, oversized input, spoofed addresses, against a fresh server.

suites.title: Approval signed on a person's device
suites.what: Enrol a device, sign a decision with it, verify it in the browser, and the ways around it that must fail. Uses a software passkey in a test browser.
